name: Fighter Ring Dancer
body:
Ring dancer fighters have learned how to bring the most out of their dancing rings as a weapon. They are capable of dual wielding the weapon, and can combine the rings’ use to make devastating attacks against enemies out of their normal reach.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

Ring dancers are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, dancing rings, and whips (including scorpion whips). They are proficient with light and medium armor, but not with shields.

This alters the fighter’s weapon and armor proficiencies.

Dancing Ring Focus (Ex)

At 1st level, a ring dancer receives dancing rings that he wears as part of his outfit. These dancing rings may be inherited from a family member, discovered before he set out to adventure, or otherwise obtained as part of becoming a ring dancer. These dancing rings are specially attuned to the ring dancer and only function for him. If stolen, they are worth only 4d10 gp.

When wielding his dancing rings, the ring dancer is treated as having the Weapon Focus feat at 1st level, Weapon Specialization at 4th level, Greater Weapon Focus at 8th level, Greater Weapon Specialization at 12th level, Penetrating Strike at 16th level, and Greater Penetrating Strike at 20th level.

This alters and replaces the fighter bonus feats gained at the listed levels.

Immortal (Su)

When a ring dancer first becomes attuned to their dancing rings (see dancing ring focus), he also becomes immortal. He ceases to age naturally and cannot die of old age unless separated from his dancing rings for longer than one week per fighter level.

Ring Versatility (Ex)

Starting at 2nd level, in addition to wielding his dancing rings as a flail, a ring dancer can also treat them as being in the close, hammer, and thrown weapon groups.

This ability replaces bravery.

Effortless Dual-Wielding (Ex)

Starting at 5th level, instead of gaining the usual weapon training benefit, a ring dancer treats dancing rings as though they were light weapons when determining his penalties on attack rolls for fighting with two weapons.

This ability alters and replaces the weapon training gained at 5th level.

Hammer Rings (Ex)

At 7th level, when a ring dancer attacks with his dancing rings as a full-attack action, he can give up his attack with the lowest attack bonus and combine both sets of rings into a single, twohanded weapon until he separates them again as a free action.

As a two-handed weapon, the rings deal 2d6 bludgeoning damage plus 1-1/2x the ring dancer’s Strength modifier. They use the higher of their enhancement bonuses, and apply the effects of all magic weapon special abilities they possess, up to a total enhancement bonus equal to half his fighter level. If combining special abilities would put the weapon above the maximum enhancement, the ring dancer must choose to suppress abilities until the total is no more than his maximum.

This replaces the armor training gained at 7th level and the fighter’s ability to move at normal speed while wearing heavy armor.
